question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

Shoaib's _______(determination) for the cause of the eradication of child labour is praiseworthy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Cowardice**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**determination**" means firmness of purpose or resoluteness.
 
• The antonym of "**determination**" is "**Cowardice**," which means lack of bravery or fearfulness.
 
• The other options: "**Contentment**," "**Sacrifice**," and "**Victory**" do not fit as appropriate antonyms.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Shoaib's cowardice__ for the cause of the eradication of child labour is praiseworthy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Contentment (संतोष)**: means a state of happiness and satisfaction.
 
• **Sacrifice (बलिदान)**: means giving up something valuable for the sake of others.
 
• **Victory (जीत)**: means winning or triumphing over a challenge or opponent.
